note: How much shared I/O CO.PRE.PAN may use and when it yields (src/coprepan/resource_policy.py). CO.RA.PAN has priority on the shared institutional share, on the shared D: device and on the C: umbrella. Every number here is a scenario assumption chosen on 2026-11-14 from the measurements named in `basis`; none is a measured optimum. A value is changed by a new version of this file, never by a run.

basis.share_write_mib_s: 3.7-5.1 MiB/s from this workstation over the VPN, ~260 ms per small file (measured 2026-10-14, docs/storage/INDEX.md 20.5); CO.RA.PAN measured 3.7 MiB/s regardless of 1, 2 or 4 streams (its STORAGE_TARGETS_AND_PRESERVATION.md 19.6, read 2026-11-14)
basis.full_baseline_minutes: the daily full re-hash of the primary took 78 min for 8,816 objects / 395,018,230 B (task start 2026-11-13T03:45Z, baseline taken 05:03:09Z; runtime evidence of preservation_backup_runs)
basis.sibling_capacity_levels: CO.RA.PAN stops local production below 20 GiB free and warns below 50 GiB on C: and on its D: volume (read 2026-11-14); CO.PRE.PAN's floor is above its warning level
basis.sibling_windows: CO.RA.PAN tasks as registered on 2026-11-14 (local time): LocalStorageMaintenance daily 03:30; HistoricBackup and RepositoryHealth Sunday 04:15 / 02:30; the backup reconcile (its backup_reconcile.py: scheduled Wednesday 02:00, but a run in progress or overdue continues in ANY night window 01:30-07:30; observed in its log: an OVERDUE run 2026-11-07 01:18Z-06:28Z continued 2026-11-08 until 03:48Z, 6.56 GB copied); live waves every 2 minutes around the clock
